en.s: The siege of Safed (13 June – 23 July 1266) was part of the campaign of the Mamluk sultan Baybars I to reduce the Kingdom of Jerusalem. The castle of Safed belonged to the Knights Templar and put up strong resistance. Direct assault, mining and psychological warfare were all employed to force the garrison to surrender. It was ultimately tricked into surrendering through treachery and the Templars were massacred.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 萨法德围城战发生于1266年6月13日至7月23日，是马穆鲁克苏丹拜巴尔一世削弱耶路撒冷王国的军事行动之一。萨法德城堡属于圣殿骑士团，守军进行了顽强抵抗。进攻方采用直接强攻、挖掘地道和心理战等手段，迫使守军投降。最终，守军因遭到背叛而被骗投降，圣殿骑士团成员随后遭到屠杀。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Chios was a naval battle fought off the shore of the eastern Aegean island of Chios between a Latin Christian—mainly Hospitaller—fleet and a Turkish fleet from the Aydinid emirate. The Christian fleet was victorious, but for the Aydinids, who had been engaging in piracy since the collapse of Byzantine power, it was only a temporary setback in their rise to prominence.

zh.s: 1319年，拉丁基督教舰队（以医院骑士团舰队为主）与艾登侯国的土耳其舰队在爱琴海东部希俄斯岛近海交战。基督教舰队获胜。但对于自拜占庭势力瓦解后一直从事海盗活动的艾登人来说，这次失败只是其崛起过程中的一次暂时挫折。

en.s: The Battle of Campo delle Mosche (Battle of the Field of the Flies) took place on 23 July 1359 in the district of Pontedera in the state of Pisa, Italy between the forces of Florence and those of the mercenary Great Company. It resulted in a victory for the Florentine forces.

zh.s: 苍蝇原野战役（意大利语：Battaglia di Campo delle Mosche，意为“苍蝇之原战役”）于1359年7月23日在意大利比萨共和国蓬泰代拉地区爆发，交战双方是佛罗伦萨军队与雇佣兵“大连队”。战斗以佛罗伦萨军队获胜告终。

en.s: The Battle of Gavere was fought near Semmerzake in Belgium on July 23, 1453 between an army under the Philip the Good of Burgundy and the rebelling city of Ghent. The army of the duke came out victorious and around 16,000 citizens of Ghent died. The battle of Gavere was part of the Revolt of Ghent.

zh.s: 1453年7月23日，勃艮第公爵“好人”菲利普率军与反叛的根特市民军在比利时塞默尔扎克附近交战。勃艮第军获胜，约有16,000名根特市民死亡。加弗雷战役是根特起义的一部分。

en.t: Conquest of the Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera (1508)
en.s: The first conquest of the Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera was undertaken on 23 July 1508 by a Spanish fleet under the command of Pedro Navarro.

zh.t: 西班牙征服韦莱斯-德拉戈梅拉岩堡（1508年）
zh.s: 1508年7月23日，佩德罗·纳瓦罗率领一支西班牙舰队，首次征服韦莱斯-德拉戈梅拉岩堡。

en.s: The Third Ottoman–Venetian War (1537–1540) was one of the Ottoman–Venetian wars which took place during the 16th century. The war arose out of the Franco-Ottoman alliance between Francis I of France and Süleyman I of the Ottoman Empire against the Holy Roman Emperor Charles V. The initial plan between the two had been to jointly invade Italy, Francis through Lombardy in the North and Süleyman through Apulia to the South.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第三次奥斯曼-威尼斯战争（1537—1540年）是16世纪奥斯曼与威尼斯之间多场战争之一。战争起因是法国国王弗朗索瓦一世与奥斯曼帝国苏丹苏莱曼一世结成联盟，共同对抗神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理五世。两人最初计划联手入侵意大利：弗朗索瓦从北方经伦巴第进攻，苏莱曼则从南方经普利亚进攻。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Antipaxos of 1537 was a naval encounter between a fleet captained by Andrea Doria, grand admiral of King of Spain and Holy Roman Emperor Charles V, and an Ottoman flotilla led by Ali Çelebi. It frames in the Italian War of 1536–1538, but events in its course led also to the beginning of the Ottoman-Venetian War of 1537-1540.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1537年，安提帕克索斯海战在安德烈亚·多里亚率领的舰队与阿里·切莱比率领的奥斯曼舰队之间展开。多里亚是西班牙国王兼神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理五世的大海军上将。这场海战属于1536年至1538年的意大利战争，其间的事件也促成了1537年至1540年奥斯曼-威尼斯战争的爆发。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Bridgwater took place in July 1645, during the First English Civil War, when a Royalist garrison surrendered to a Parliamentarian force under Sir Thomas Fairfax. After their victory at Naseby in June, Fairfax and the New Model Army moved into Somerset, where they linked up with the Western Association Army led by Edward Massey.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1645年7月，第一次英国内战期间，布里奇沃特的保王党守军向托马斯·费尔法克斯爵士率领的议会军投降。费尔法克斯和新模范军于6月在纳斯比获胜后进入萨默塞特郡，并与爱德华·梅西率领的西部协会军会合。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Ebeltoft was a naval battle between a Swedish and a Danish/Dutch fleet, during the Dano-Swedish War of 1658 to 1660. The allied fleet was ordered to secure a troop transport fleet to the Swedish-controlled island Fyn. Eight Swedish frigates under the command of Owen Coxe attacked the fleet and took the allies by surprise.

zh.s: 埃贝尔托夫特海战是丹麦-瑞典战争期间瑞典舰队与丹麦-荷兰联军之间的一场海战。联军奉命护送一支运兵船队前往由瑞典控制的菲英岛。欧文·考克斯指挥的八艘瑞典护卫舰袭击了船队，打了联军一个措手不及。

en.s: The battle of Marstrand was a successful Danish-Norwegian siege of the harbor town of Marstrand, Sweden which took place between 6 and 23 July 1677, during the Scanian War.

zh.s: 马斯特兰德战役是丹麦-挪威军队对瑞典港口城镇马斯特兰德发动的一场围城战，最终获胜。战役发生于1677年7月6日至23日，是斯堪尼亚战争的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Ortenbach, also known as the Battle of Gengenbach, took place on 23 July 1678 during the closing stages of the 1672-1678 Franco-Dutch War, in the modern German state of Baden-Württemberg. It featured a French army commanded by François de Créquy and an Imperial force under Charles V, Duke of Lorraine.

zh.s: 奥滕巴赫战役又称根根巴赫战役，于1678年7月23日爆发，正值1672年至1678年法荷战争的最后阶段，地点在今德国巴登-符腾堡州。法军由弗朗索瓦·德·克雷基指挥，神圣罗马帝国军队则由洛林公爵查理五世率领。

en.s: The Bombardment of Chios, was a diplomatic crisis that occurred between the Ottoman Empire and the Kingdom of France in 1681. In response to the damage caused by the French fleet under the command of Abraham Duquesne by bombarding Chios on July 23, 1681 under the pretext of pursuing the ships of Tripoli, the Ottoman navy under the command of Bozoklu Mustafa Pasha blockaded the French fleet.

zh.s: 1681年，奥斯曼帝国与法国王国之间爆发外交危机。法国舰队在亚伯拉罕·迪凯纳指挥下，于1681年7月23日以追击的黎波里船只为名炮击希俄斯岛，造成破坏。作为回应，博佐克卢·穆斯塔法帕夏指挥的奥斯曼海军封锁了法国舰队。

en.s: The Battle of Endirey was a major confrontation between the Russian Empire and its allies with the Chechens and Kumyks and took place in a gorge on the Aktash River near Endirey. An army sent led by Brigadier Andrei Veterani was encircled by a combined Chechen–Kumyk force, as a result of which the corps was defeated and forced to retreat.

zh.s: 恩迪雷战役是俄罗斯帝国及其盟军与车臣人、库梅克人之间的一场重要交锋，发生在恩迪雷附近的阿克塔什河峡谷。安德烈·维特拉尼准将率军出征，却遭车臣-库梅克联军包围，部队因此被击败并被迫撤退。

en.s: The siege of Mons took place from 7 June to 23 July 1746 during the War of the Austrian Succession. The town of Mons, then part of the Austrian Netherlands, was besieged by a French army corps commanded by Louis François, Prince of Conti. The Austrian and Dutch defenders surrendered the town of Mons on 10 July, while the citadel fell to the French on 23 July.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 蒙斯围城战于1746年6月7日至7月23日在奥地利王位继承战争期间进行。当时蒙斯属于奥属尼德兰，由路易-弗朗索瓦·德·波旁，孔蒂亲王指挥的法军围攻。奥地利和荷兰守军于7月10日交出蒙斯城，城堡则于7月23日被法军攻陷。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Sabbath Day Point took place on 23 July 1757 just off the shore of Sabbath Day Point, Lake George, New York and ended in a French victory. The battle (actually better described as an ambush), pitched approximately 450 French and allied Indian forces under the leadership of Ensign de Corbiere of the Troupes de la Marine against 350 New Jersey Blues under the command of Colonel John Parker.

zh.s: 安息日角战役于1757年7月23日在纽约州乔治湖安息日角岸边近海发生，以法军获胜告终。这场战斗更准确地说是一场伏击：海军陆战队少尉德·科比埃尔率领约450名法国及其原住民盟军，与约翰·帕克上校指挥的350名新泽西蓝军交战。

en.s: The Battle of Kay (German: Schlacht bei Kay), also referred to as the Battle of Sulechów or Battle of Paltzig, was a battle fought on 23 July 1759 during the Seven Years' War. It occurred near Kay (Kije) in the Neumark, now part of Poland. General Carl Heinrich von Wedel, the commander of the Prussian army of 26,000 men, unwisely attacked a larger Russian army of 70,000 men commanded by Count Pyotr Saltykov, and was defeated. The Prussians lost 8,300 men; the Russians lost less than 5,000 men.

zh.s: 凯战役又称苏莱胡夫战役或帕尔茨希战役（德语：Schlacht bei Kay），发生于1759年7月23日七年战争期间，地点在纽马克的凯（今波兰基耶）附近。卡尔·海因里希·冯·韦德尔将军率领26,000名普军，贸然进攻彼得·萨尔蒂科夫伯爵指挥的70,000名俄军，结果战败。普军损失8,300人，俄军损失不到5,000人。

en.s: The Capture of Delhi, fought in 1760, pitted the forces of the Maratha Empire against those of the Durrani Empire led by Yakub Ali Khan. The Maratha army was commanded by Sadashivrao Bhau, a prominent military leader and cousin of the Maratha Peshwa Balaji Baji Rao. The Durrani army, on the other hand, was led by Yakub Ali Khan, a trusted general of Ahmad Shah Durrani, the founder of the Durrani Empire.

zh.s: 1760年的德里之战由马拉塔帝国军队对阵杜兰尼帝国军队，后者由雅库布·阿里汗率领。马拉塔军队由重要军事领袖、马拉塔佩什瓦巴拉吉·巴吉·拉奥的表亲萨达希夫拉奥·巴乌指挥。杜兰尼军队则由杜兰尼帝国的创建者艾哈迈德·沙阿·杜兰尼的得力将领雅库布·阿里汗率领。

en.s: In the siege of Mainz (German: Belagerung von Mainz), from 14 April to 23 July 1793, a coalition of Prussia, Austria, and other German states led by the Holy Roman Empire besieged and captured Mainz from revolutionary French forces. The allies, especially the Prussians, first tried negotiations, but this failed, and the bombardment of the city began on the night of 17 June.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1793年4月14日至7月23日，普鲁士、奥地利和其他德意志邦国组成的联军在神圣罗马帝国领导下围攻并从革命派法军手中夺取美因茨。盟军，尤其是普鲁士军队，起初尝试谈判，但未能成功，随后于6月17日晚开始炮轰该城。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Irish rebellion of 1803 was an attempt by Irish republicans to seize the seat of the British government in Ireland, Dublin Castle, and trigger a nationwide insurrection. Renewing the struggle of 1798, they were organised under a reconstituted United Irish directorate. Hopes of French aid, of a diversionary rising by radical militants in England, and of Presbyterians in the north-east rallying once more to the cause of a republic were disappointed.

zh.s: 1803年爱尔兰起义是爱尔兰共和派试图夺取爱尔兰英国政府所在地都柏林城堡并引发全国起义的一次行动。起义者重新发起1798年的斗争，由重组后的联合爱尔兰人组织领导。他们原本希望得到法国援助、英国激进武装分子发动牵制性起义，以及东北部长老会派再次支持共和事业，但这些希望都落空了。

en.s: Battle of Silda (Affæren ved Silden or Affæren ved Stadt) was a naval battle fought on 23 July 1810 between the United Kingdom and Denmark–Norway near the Norwegian island of Silda in Sogn og Fjordane county. The battle occurred during the Gunboat War, itself part of the Napoleonic Wars. In the battle, two British frigates captured or destroyed three or four Dano-Norwegian gunboats.

zh.s: 希尔达海战（丹麦语：Affæren ved Silden或Affæren ved Stadt）于1810年7月23日在挪威松恩-菲尤拉讷郡的希尔达岛附近爆发，交战双方为英国和丹麦-挪威。战斗发生在炮艇战争期间，而炮艇战争是拿破仑战争的一部分。两艘英国护卫舰俘获或击毁了三至四艘丹麦-挪威炮艇。

en.t: Portuguese invasion of the Banda Oriental (1811–1812)
en.s: The Portuguese invasion of the Banda Oriental was a short-lived attempt, beginning in 1811 and ending the following year, by the Portuguese Empire to annex the remaining territory of the Spanish Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 葡萄牙帝国曾短暂试图吞并拉普拉塔总督辖区剩余领土，其入侵东岸省的行动始于1811年，并于次年结束。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of García Hernández was fought on 23 July 1812 during the Peninsular War. In the battle, two cavalry brigades of the British Army's King's German Legion (KGL) under Major-General Eberhardt Otto George von Bock defeated 4,000 French troops led by General Maximilien Sébastien Foy. In what would otherwise have been an unremarkable skirmish, the KGL dragoons achieved the unusual feat of breaking two French squares, those of the 6th, 69th and 76th Line, routing the entire French force with heavy losses.

zh.t: 加西亚·埃尔南德斯战役
zh.s: 加西亚·埃尔南德斯战役于1812年7月23日在半岛战争期间爆发。英国军队所属德意志军团的两个骑兵旅由埃伯哈特·奥托·格奥尔格·冯·博克少将指挥，击败了马克西米连·塞巴斯蒂安·福瓦将军率领的4,000名法军。在一场原本并不起眼的遭遇战中，德意志军团龙骑兵罕见地冲破了法军第6、第69和第76线列步兵团组成的两个方阵，并击溃了整支法军，造成其重大损失。

en.s: The Battle of Saltanovka, also known as the Battle of Mogilev (French: Bataille de Mogilev), took place on 23 July 1812 during the early stages of the 1812 French invasion of Russia.

zh.s: 萨尔塔诺夫卡战役又称莫吉廖夫战役（法语：Bataille de Mogilev），于1812年7月23日在法国入侵俄国的早期阶段爆发。

en.s: The siege of Huajuapan de León was a battle of the Mexican War of Independence that was fought from 5 April to 23 July 1812 at Huajuapan de León, in the Mexican state of Oaxaca. The battle was fought between the royalist forces loyal to the Spanish crown, and the Mexican rebels fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 瓦华潘-德莱昂围城战是墨西哥独立战争中的一场战斗，于1812年4月5日至7月23日在墨西哥瓦哈卡州的瓦华潘-德莱昂进行。交战双方是效忠西班牙王室的保王党军队，以及争取脱离西班牙帝国独立的墨西哥起义军。

en.s: The Battle of Ponte Ferreira, fought on 22–23 July 1832, was the first major battle of the Portuguese Civil War between the forces of Dom Pedro, ex-Emperor of Brazil and Regent for his daughter Maria da Glória, and the army of his brother Dom Miguel, who had usurped the throne of Portugal.

zh.s: 蓬特费雷拉战役于1832年7月22日至23日爆发，是葡萄牙内战中的第一场重大战役。交战双方分别是巴西前皇帝、其女玛丽亚·达格洛里亚的摄政唐·佩德罗，以及他的兄弟唐·米格尔率领的军队。米格尔篡夺了葡萄牙王位。

en.s: The Battle of Ghazni (or Ghuznee) took place in the city of Ghazni in central Afghanistan on July 23, 1839 during the First Anglo-Afghan War.

zh.s: 加兹尼战役又称古兹尼战役，于1839年7月23日在阿富汗中部城市加兹尼发生，是第一次英阿战争的一场战役。

en.s: The Battle of the Caloosahatchee, also called the Caloosahatchee Massacre, was a battle that took place during the Second Seminole War on July 23, 1839. A large, diverse group of allied Native Americans attacked a trading post and U.S. Army encampment along the Caloosahatchee River near modern North Fort Myers. The U.S. Army troops were part of the 2nd Cavalry Regiment and under the command of Lieutenant Colonel William Harney.

zh.s: 卡卢萨哈奇河战役又称卡卢萨哈奇河大屠杀，是第二次塞米诺尔战争期间的一场战斗，发生于1839年7月23日。一支由多族群组成的美洲原住民联盟大军，袭击了卡卢萨哈奇河沿岸的一处贸易站和美国陆军营地，地点靠近今北迈尔斯堡。美国陆军部队隶属第二骑兵团，由威廉·哈尼中校指挥。

en.s: The Battle of the Valerik River on 11 July 1840 was fought as part of the Russian conquest of the Caucasus. It occurred about 30 km (19 miles) southwest of the fortress of Groznaya (now Grozny) between forces of the Imperial Russian Army and North Caucasian mountaineers led by the naib (viceroy) Ahberdila Muhammad. It remains famous because of the poem "Valerik" by Mikhail Lermontov, a participant.

en.s: The Battle of Manassas Gap, also known as the Battle of Wapping Heights, took place on July 23, 1863, in Warren County, Virginia, at the conclusion of General Robert E. Lee's retreat back to Virginia in the final days of the Gettysburg Campaign of the American Civil War. Union forces attempted to force passage across the Blue Ridge Mountains and attack the Confederate rear as it formed a defensive position in the upper Shenandoah Valley. Despite successfully forcing the passage at Manassas Gap, the Union force was unable to do so before Lee retreated further up the valley to safety, resulting in an inconclusive battle.

en.s: World Gymnastics, formerly the International Gymnastics Federation, is the body governing competition in all disciplines of gymnastics. Its headquarters is in Lausanne, Switzerland. It was founded on 23 July 1881 in Liège, Belgium, making it the world's oldest existing international sports organisation. Originally called the European Federation of Gymnastics, it had three member countries — Belgium, France and the Netherlands — until 1921, when non-European countries were admitted and the organization changed its name to the Fédération Internationale de Gymnastique.

zh.s: 世界体操联合会原名国际体操联合会，是管理各类体操项目竞赛的机构，总部位于瑞士洛桑。该组织于1881年7月23日在比利时列日成立，是现存历史最悠久的国际体育组织。它最初名为欧洲体操联合会，直到1921年接纳非欧洲国家后才更名为国际体操联合会。成立之初，它有三个成员国：比利时、法国和荷兰。

Imperial Japanese forces led by Japanese Minister Plenipotentiary to Korea Ōtori Keisuke and Ōshima Yoshimasa occupied Gyeongbokgung palace to restore King Gojong's father Heungseon Daewongun and establish a pro-Japanese government under Kim Hong-jip and the Enlightenment Party's administration.

en.s: The Battle of Manimani was a failed American landing attempt west of Bahia Honda, Cuba. On July 23, 1898, the U.S.S. The ship eventually reached safety after Lieutenant John Heard took their position and transmitted orders to the engine room.

en.s: Alexander I Karađorđević (Serbo-Croatian: Александар I Карађорђевић, Aleksandar I Karađorđević, 16 December [O.S. 4 December] 1888 – 9 October 1934) was King of the Serbs, Croats and Slovenes from 16 August 1921 to 3 October 1929 and King of Yugoslavia from 3 October 1929 until his assassination. en.t: Jackie Robinson becomes the first African American to be inducted into the National Baseball Hall of Fame
en.s: Jack Roosevelt Robinson (January 31, 1919 – October 24, 1972) was an American professional baseball player who was the first African American to play in Major League Baseball (MLB) in the modern era. zh.s: 杰克·罗斯福·罗宾逊（1919年1月31日—1972年10月24日）是美国职业棒球运动员，也是现代大联盟棒球（MLB）中的首位非裔美国球员。1947年4月15日，他以一垒手身份代表布鲁克林道奇队出场，打破了种族隔离界限。道奇队签下罗宾逊，预示着职业棒球种族隔离的结束；自19世纪80年代以来，黑人球员一直被排除在大联盟之外，只能参加黑人联盟。

It was a modified version of the Nimbus 4 meteorological satellite and was launched on July 23, 1972, by a Delta 0900 rocket from Vandenberg Air Force Base in California. It was the first satellite to carry a Multispectral Scanner.

en.s: On July 23, 1982, a Bell UH-1 Iroquois helicopter crashed at Indian Dunes in Valencia, Santa Clarita, California, during the making of Twilight Zone: The Movie. The crash killed three people on the ground – actor Vic Morrow and two child actors, Myca Dinh Le and Renee Shin-Yi Chen – as well as injuring the six helicopter passengers. The incident led to years of civil and criminal action, and was directly responsible for the introduction of new procedures and safety standards within the filmmaking industry.

en.s: The Sri Lankan civil war was fought in Sri Lanka from 1983 to 2009. Beginning on 23 July 1983, it was an intermittent insurgency against the government by the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE, also known as the Tamil Tigers) led by Velupillai Prabhakaran. The LTTE fought to create an independent Tamil state called Tamil Eelam in the north-east of the island in response to continuous discrimination and violent persecution against Sri Lankan Tamils by the predominantly Sinhalese government of Sri Lanka.

zh.s: 斯里兰卡内战发生于1983年至2009年。战争于1983年7月23日开始，是维卢皮莱·普拉巴卡兰领导的泰米尔伊拉姆猛虎解放组织（LTTE，又称泰米尔猛虎组织）间歇性反抗政府的武装冲突。该组织为在斯里兰卡东北部建立独立的泰米尔国家“泰米尔伊拉姆”而战，背景是以僧伽罗人为主的斯里兰卡政府长期歧视并暴力迫害斯里兰卡泰米尔人。

en.s: Four Four Bravo was the call sign of a fifteen-man Sri Lankan Army patrol, deployed in the Jaffna Peninsula on 23 July 1983. The patrol was ambushed and thirteen of its members were killed by the LTTE. This incident sparked the Thirunelveli massacre and the Black July riots and is considered to be the start of the Sri Lankan Civil War.

zh.s: “Four Four Bravo”是斯里兰卡陆军一支15人巡逻队的呼号。1983年7月23日，这支巡逻队在贾夫纳半岛执行任务时遭到伏击，13名队员被泰米尔伊拉姆猛虎解放组织（LTTE）杀害。该事件引发蒂鲁内尔维利大屠杀和“黑色七月”骚乱，并被视为斯里兰卡内战的开端。

en.t: The Brawl to End It All
en.s: The Brawl to End It All was a professional wrestling event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF) and broadcast live on MTV. It took place at Madison Square Garden in New York, New York on July 23, 1984. The show was a major event in the Rock 'n' Wrestling Connection in the mid-1980s WWF. The main event featured The Fabulous Moolah defending the WWF Women's Championship against Wendi Richter. Richter pinned Moolah to win the Women's Championship. It was the only match of the event that was shown on national television. The entire event was recorded and shown on the Madison Square Garden Network however.

zh.s: 《终结一切的混战》是世界摔角联盟（WWF）主办、并由MTV现场直播的一场职业摔角赛事，于1984年7月23日在纽约市麦迪逊广场花园举行。这是20世纪80年代中期WWF“摇滚与摔角”合作热潮中的一场重要赛事。主赛中，伟大的穆拉卫冕WWF女子冠军，对手是温迪·里希特。里希特压制穆拉，赢得女子冠军。这是赛事中唯一一场在全国电视上播出的比赛；不过，整场赛事都被录制下来，并在麦迪逊广场花园电视网播出。

en.s: Elections for the Japanese House of Councillors were held in Japan on 23 July 1989. The election result was a setback for ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) because of the Recruit scandal, the introduction of a 3% consumption tax, and the involvement of Prime Minister Uno Sōsuke in a sex scandal. This is the first time that the LDP lost the majority in the House of Councillors. Until 2016, due to the House of Councillors without a simple majority, LDP need to cooperate and form coalitions with other parties. The Japan Socialist Party-led oppositions won a majority of seats.

zh.s: 日本于1989年7月23日举行参议院选举。执政自民党（LDP）受到重挫，原因包括Recruit丑闻、开征3%的消费税，以及首相宇野宗佑卷入性丑闻。这是自民党首次失去参议院多数席位。由于参议院此后未能形成简单多数，自民党必须与其他政党合作并组建执政联盟，这种情况持续到2016年。以日本社会党为首的反对党赢得多数席位。

en.s: Fully Loaded (2000) was the third and final Fully Loaded professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Federation (WWF). It was presented by Twix and took place on July 23, 2000, at the Reunion Arena in Dallas, Texas. The main event was a standard wrestling match for the WWF Championship. The Rock defended the title against Chris Benoit. The match stipulated that if Rock was disqualified, he would lose the title. He was disqualified, and as a result, Benoit won the title. However, the WWF Commissioner Mick Foley restarted the match. Rock then pinned Benoit after a Rock Bottom to retain the title.

zh.s: 《Fully Loaded》（2000）是世界摔角联盟（WWF）举办的第三场、也是最后一场同名职业摔角按次付费赛事，由Twix赞助。赛事于2000年7月23日在得克萨斯州达拉斯的团圆体育馆举行。主赛是WWF冠军赛，巨石强森对阵克里斯·贝努瓦。比赛规定，如果巨石强森被取消资格，就会失去冠军头衔。他确实被取消资格，贝努瓦因此一度获胜。但WWF专员米克·弗利重新开始了比赛，随后巨石强森用岩石底击倒贝努瓦并压制获胜，成功卫冕。

en.s: The 2000 Bangkok gubernatorial election was the sixth election for the governorship of Bangkok, and was held on 23 July 2000. The election saw the independent candidate, Samak Sundaravej, beat the Thai Rak Thai candidate, Sudarat Keyuraphan. The election also saw Samak become the first candidate in a Bangkok gubernatorial election to reach more than a million votes, which he did with a total 1,016,096 votes.

zh.s: 2000年曼谷市长选举是曼谷第六次市长选举，于2000年7月23日举行。无党籍候选人萨马克·顺达卫击败泰爱泰党候选人素达拉·柯凯育帕。萨马克的得票数为1,016,096票，成为曼谷市长选举中首位获得超过100万票的候选人。

en.s: Diah Permata Megawati Setiawati Sukarnoputri (Indonesian: [meɡawati sukarnɔputri] ; born 23 January 1947) is an Indonesian politician who served as the fifth president of Indonesia from 2001 to 2004 and the eighth vice president under President Abdurrahman Wahid from 1999 to 2001. She is Indonesia's first and only female president to date, and also the first president born in Indonesia after its independence.

zh.t: 梅加瓦蒂·苏加诺普特丽就任印度尼西亚总统
zh.s: 迪娅·佩尔马塔·梅加瓦蒂·塞蒂亚瓦蒂·苏加诺普特丽（印度尼西亚语：[meɡawati sukarnɔputri]；1947年1月23日出生）是印度尼西亚政治人物，2001年至2004年担任印度尼西亚第五任总统，1999年至2001年担任阿卜杜拉赫曼·瓦希德总统任内的第八任副总统。她是印度尼西亚迄今唯一一位女性总统，也是印度尼西亚独立后出生的首位总统。

en.s: The 2006–07 Egyptian Super Cup was the sixth edition of the Egyptian Super Cup, an annual football match between the winners of the previous season's Egyptian Premier League and Egypt Cup. The match is usually contested by the winners of the Premier League and the Egypt Cup, but since Al Ahly won the double (2005–06 Egyptian Premier League and 2005–06 Egypt Cup), ENPPI qualified instead of Zamalek (second-placed in the league and cup), who was prevented from playing the match by decision of the football association.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Kyrgyzstan on 23 July 2009. The date was set after the constitutional court ruled that the extension of the presidential term from four to five years did not apply until the next presidential election, calling for elections by 25 October 2009; in response, a parliament committee proposed the July election date, which was then passed by the incumbent president Kurmanbek Bakiyev's Ak Jol-dominated parliament.

zh.s: 吉尔吉斯斯坦于2009年7月23日举行总统选举。宪法法院裁定，总统任期从四年延长至五年的规定要到下一次总统选举才生效，并要求在2009年10月25日前举行选举。作为回应，议会委员会提议将选举安排在7月，随后由现任总统库尔曼别克·巴基耶夫所属阿克若尔党占多数的议会通过了这一日期。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Norwich North was held on 23 July 2009, following the resignation of incumbent Labour Party MP Ian Gibson after being banned from standing as the party's candidate at the next general election due to the MPs' expenses scandal. en.s: On July 23, 2010, a NATO attack killed and injured many Afghan civilians, most of whom were women and children, in the village of Sangin in Helmand province, Afghanistan. The Afghan government claimed that a helicopter-gunship rocket strike killed 52 civilians. Many other civilians including children were also injured and treated at Kandahar hospital. en.s: One Direction, often shortened to 1D, were an English–Irish pop boy band formed in London in 2010. en.t: The Solar storm of 2012 was an unusually large coronal mass ejection that was emitted by the Sun which barely missed the Earth by nine days. If it hit, it would have caused up to US$2.6 trillion in damages to electrical equipment worldwide
en.s: On July 23, 2012 at 02:08 UTC, a solar storm involving an unusually large and strong coronal mass ejection occurred. It missed Earth by a margin of roughly nine days, as the Sun's equator rotates around its own axis once over a period of about 27 days. The region that produced the outburst was thus not pointed directly towards Earth at that time.

en.s: TransAsia Airways Flight 222 (GE222/TNA222) was a scheduled domestic passenger flight operated by TransAsia Airways from Kaohsiung International Airport in Kaohsiung to Magong Airport in Magong, Penghu Island. en.s: The 2016 Belgian Super Cup was a football match that took take place on 23 July 2016, between the 2015–16 Belgian Pro League winners Club Brugge and Standard Liège, the winners of the 2015–16 Belgian Cup. Club Brugge played their 17th Super Cup and featured in their second consecutive Super Cup after losing the 2015 Belgian Super Cup to Gent, while Standard Liège played their 8th Belgian Super Cup after last appearing in 2011 when they lost to Genk.

en.s: The 2017 Battleground was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brand, SmackDown. It was the fifth annual Battleground and took place on July 23, 2017, at the Wells Fargo Center in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Eight matches were contested at the event, including one match on the Kickoff pre-show.

en.s: The Idlib Governorate clashes (July 2017) were a series of military confrontations between Ahrar al-Sham and Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS). During the clashes, Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham attempted to capture the Bab al-Hawa Border Crossing, causing concern for Turkey, which prefers Ahrar al-Sham to be in control of the crossing. As a result of the clashes, HTS took control of Idlib city, the Bab al-Hawa Border Crossing, and most of the areas along the Turkish border in the Idlib Province.

en.s: A general election was held in Spain on 23 July 2023 to elect the members of the 15th Cortes Generales under the Spanish Constitution of 1978. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 208 of 266 seats in the Senate. It was the first time since 1839 that a general election in Spain was held in the month of July.

zh.s: 西班牙于2023年7月23日举行大选，依照1978年宪法选出第十五届议会成员。众议院350个席位全部改选，参议院266个席位中有208席改选。自1839年以来，这是西班牙首次在7月举行大选。

en.s: The 2023 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship final was a hurling match played at Croke Park in Dublin on 23 July 2023 between Kilkenny and Limerick, the culmination of the 2023 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship. It was the 136th final of that sport's primary competition, the All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship. Reigning title holder Limerick won the game by 0–30 to 2–15 to claim their four-in-a-row and their fifth title in six years.

en.s: The 2025 Major League Soccer All-Star Game was the 29th annual Major League Soccer All-Star Game, an exhibition soccer match in the United States. It featured all-star squads from Major League Soccer (MLS) and Liga MX of Mexico—the fourth edition to use the inter-league format.
